svg.title: Baseline architecture
svg.desc: A Swin Transformer backbone produces four hierarchical stage maps; a feature pyramid network unifies them to 256 channels; global average pooling and concatenation give a 1024-dimensional fused descriptor; an optional magnification embedding is concatenated to that descriptor, giving 1088 dimensions, before the single linear classification head, an optional projection head carries the supervised contrastive loss, and the classification head yields the benign versus malignant prediction.
